info.title: Work Tracker API
info.description: Working days, task entries, overtime and PTO.

get.summary: Handles GET requests. Responds with plain text, not JSON.
Every calendar day of a week or date range, recorded or not; `member` shows a member of the team admin's team (team view: no notes or review flags; days before they joined the team without data).

parameters.name: member

schema.description: Team view: id (UUID) of a member of the team admin's team
schema.title: Member

parameters.description: Team view: id (UUID) of a member of the team admin's team

post.summary: Book a full-day type (e.g. PTO) on the work days of a range, or preview it.
post.description: Days off of the schedule, public holidays and company half days are left out. Work days holding times or entries are refused (409), skipped or booked too, as `conflicts` says; all days are saved or none.

delete.summary: Delete a recorded day and its review flags.

get.summary: One calendar day, recorded or not.
Entries of a week or date range, by date and in the order they were created; `member` shows a member of the team admin's team (team view: from the day they joined the team).

parameters.name: member

schema.description: Team view: id (UUID) of a member of the team admin's team
schema.title: Member

parameters.description: Team view: id (UUID) of a member of the team admin's team

post.summary: Create an entry; a new ticket is created, `service_id` sets the ticket's service.

delete.summary: Delete an entry and its review flags; its history is kept.

get.summary: One entry.

put.summary: Change an entry; only changed fields are written to its history. The kind cannot change.

get.summary: The history of an entry, oldest first; also available after the entry was deleted.

post.summary: Divide a ticket entry among several tickets (e.g. an alias like #4347 aka #1482), hours split evenly.

get.summary: All tickets (sorted by prefix and number) with their service and number of entries.

parameters.name: without_service

schema.description: Only tickets without a service (for review)
schema.title: Without Service

parameters.description: Only tickets without a service (for review)

post.summary: Assign one service to several tickets at once; if a ticket is unknown, nothing changes.

get.summary: A known ticket with the service it remembers (used to pre-fill the service of a new entry).

put.summary: Set or unassign the service of a ticket; it applies to all entries of the ticket.

post.summary: Rename a ticket, or merge it into an existing one (which keeps its service); recorded in each entry's history.

get.summary: Key figures, the overtime balance over time, days off coming up and this year's figures, up to today; `member` shows a member of the team admin's team (team view, logged for the member).

parameters.name: member

schema.description: Team view: id (UUID) of a member of the team admin's team
schema.title: Member

parameters.description: Team view: id (UUID) of a member of the team admin's team

get.summary: Start date and opening balance of the overtime balance.

put.summary: Change the start date and opening balance; reports count from the new start day on.

get.summary: The color theme of all pages.

put.summary: Choose the color theme: system, light or dark.

get.summary: Whether the user's data is set up (not logged in: a new database's); until then, pages forward to /setup.

post.summary: Set up the user's data at once: start day, opening balance, work schedule, PTO years and services. On a new database, it first creates the first user (`user`), who takes over its data and is logged in.
post.description: The schedule applies from the start day; PTO is entered for the first year and the year after. Refused (409) once set up: then the settings page changes everything.

get.summary: Whether the login is on, whether a user exists, who is logged in (with their team and number of open invitations), and whether new users can register.

post.summary: Log in with username or e-mail address; sets the session cookie (valid 24 h since the last activity).
post.description: After 5 failed logins or registrations within a minute, logins pause (429). A deactivated user is refused (403).

post.summary: Log out: ends the session and removes the cookie.
Create the first user of a database that has none, and log in; refused (409) once a user exists.
Register a new user and log in; the user then goes through the setup. Only while an admin has switched registration on (404 otherwise, and with the login off).
post.description: Registrations count towards the pause after failed logins: after 5 within a minute, both pause (429).

get.summary: The logged-in user.

put.summary: Change username, e-mail address and name of the logged-in user.
Change the password: ends all sessions of the user and starts a new one for this browser.

get.summary: All users in the order they registered, with role, status, registration, last login and team.

put.summary: Change a user's role, or deactivate (their sessions end, their data is kept) or reactivate them.
put.description: Nobody demotes or deactivates themselves (409), so an active admin always remains. Only a member of a team can be a team admin (409); they manage that team.

get.summary: App-wide settings: whether new users can register.

put.summary: Switch registration on or off; the login page links to /register only while it is on.

get.summary: All teams with their number of members and their team admins.

post.summary: Create a team; names are unique, ignoring case (409).

delete.summary: Delete a team without members (409 otherwise); its invitations and services go with it, the membership history keeps it.

get.summary: The team with its members (accounts only) and open invitations.

post.summary: Invite the user with this exact e-mail address (ignoring case); the answer does not tell whether they exist.

delete.summary: Remove a member: the team services their tickets use become personal services; a team admin becomes a user.

get.summary: The team's services, which its members choose in entries.

delete.summary: Delete a team service; the members' tickets with it become "without service".
Leave the team: the team services the user's tickets use become personal services.

get.summary: The user's team (null without one) and their open invitations.

post.summary: Accept an invitation: join the team (leaving the current one); the other invitations are declined.

get.summary: All work schedules, oldest first; each applies until the next one starts.

post.summary: Add a work schedule; it applies from its start date until the next one starts.

delete.summary: Delete a work schedule (not the only one); its days then follow the schedule before it.

get.summary: One work schedule.

put.summary: Change a work schedule; the days it applies to are counted again.

get.summary: Every year with PTO days entered, oldest first.

delete.summary: Delete the PTO days of a year; the year then has no PTO account.

get.summary: The PTO days of one year.

put.summary: Enter the PTO days of a year (insert or replace).

get.summary: Everything that needs attention; an item disappears once its reason is fixed or its flag is cleared.

delete.summary: Clear a review flag of an entry or a day (e.g. after checking a guessed ticket key).

get.summary: All records of the list.
One record.
The services to choose in entries: the team's (`team`: its name) first, then the personal ones.
All records of the list.
One record.
